intro: The Adventurer is an introductory task given by Executor Arren to seasoned young Forsaken champions outside Deathknell. Having proven reliable in strikes against the Scarlet Crusade, you are dispatched up the road toward Brill to investigate a stranger lingering near the settlement. Rather than uncovering another zealot spy, the task introduces you to Eleanor Shackleton, an independent traveler eager to teach the practical survival skills of the wild.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.
I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm not affiliated with the Scarlet Crusade, if you couldn't tell. I'm just an adventurer stopping by before my next venture into the wilderness.
Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
